config_warnings: Aggregate capacity sum(C)=96 != K*T=128. The capacity dual is then not gauge-invariant; the relative controller observes only the quotient component. Track aggregate shortage separately.
controller_notes: admitted_antiwindup: conditional-integration anti-windup on the admitted signal. Per-coordinate saturation is R_e >= C_e; saturated coordinates are frozen at the unsaturated mean before the zero-sum projection (their relative feedback is exactly 0), unsaturated coordinates integrate A_e/(K*T) - mu_e, and global saturation gives epsilon = 0 (full integrator freeze). Reduces to admitted feedback bit-identically on the gauge quotient when nothing is saturated.

gauge_equivalence.note: Under uniform capacity and uniform target, (requested) and (capacity_relative) feedback vectors are identical, and (admitted) and (admitted_centered) differ only by a common-mode component removed by gauge projection. Do not count equivalent variants as independent scientific findings. The requested_leaky and requested_no_projection ablations share the requested feedback vector exactly; they differ only in dynamics (leak / projection).
